CSE-173 : SLE
Teaching: decent for learning, clears all concepts and gives exercises as hw. The thing is, sir has still some lacking of knowledge in this course as he is taking it after a long time. Sometimes he fails to give you the proper answer you need. And sometimes he just ignores or will suggest you to meet him during office hours.

NOT RECOMMENDED. TAKE AT YOUR OWN RISK.

Bhai sorry, you must be someone from the braindead following he has. He is not the finest faculty NSU will offer you. Faculties like sfr1,sva, etc. teach way better than him. To begin with, he makes the class environment very toxic. As a result, nobody dares to ask him any questions. For the record, I got a decent grade under him. His Attitude and Pretentious behavior attract such followers not for his teaching

Being demanding and pushing students has little to do with toxicity or pretentiousness. His approach might not suit you and you have the freedom to opt for other sections. Cs jobs are challenging and stressful, so getting used to a competitive environment early might boost your confidence and resilience. These meta-skills are priceless.

In undergraduate I don’t think a student should need rely on study suggestions.
CSE173 is one of the most important, base foundational course and with that in mind to do good you should practice a lot not just from book but also from countless resources available online.
Sir give a lot of partial marks so even if you try to approach a problem rationally based on what sir taught you, Sir will give you good marks for it.
Before class you should have brushed up your basic knowledge. Ask sir/TA questions after class in his office hours after trying to understand it by yourself. Even if he insults you, reflect on it. I was his student and TA for a year, sir himself told me that he appreciates if someone comes to him.
Every teacher has different approaches. After mid or quizzes you could ask for suggestions on how to tackle. Moreover it’s a 2nd semester course so you have a time to practice thats why it’s absolutely necessary too.
Next time if you see that you are having such problems with a faculty after quizzes try to consult with ones that did the course with that faculty.

SFT is nice. Just the thing is you need to be really focused, attentive, and observant in his class to understand the topic. If you get distracted for even 1 minute, you'll be lost. But overall he's good. Plus point: if you don't understand what he says, go through the slides. You NEED to do SELF STUDY of course. If aren't into self-studying, he ain't for you.
(I have heard je uni learning er jonno bhalo na, but honestly, from prior experiences, I can say he's a thousand times better than many others.)
Pros:
1. His lectures are comprehensive and honestly pretty easy
2. He doesn't skip any topic from the syllabus. I have heard many faculties do. Ami in case kichu na bujhle amr oneek friend jara ei course ta amr aage kore felse ode jiggesh korle many time answer paisi je amder faculty oi topic ta skip korse
3. Sir has a very comprehensive lecture schedule, designed as per the student's need. He will start with "Set" (a topic we are familiar with) then gradually move to other topics and end with logic and number theory (topics we are less familiar with) whereas in most cases faculties start with logic. So yeah, it helps a lot.
3. If you can't understand any part, ask him, sir will explain it. If still have any troubles, go through the slides by yourself and you'll understand the topic.
4. Yes, he repeats questions or at least, makes them similar, so collect the previous year's questions and solve them.
5. If you want to make your basic strong, solve all the odd questions from the Exercise of the book.
6. Questions are easy.
7. Sir tries his best to teach you!!!!
8. Really easy going.
Not so sure about grading tho. (Update: He curves depending on the section)
Inbox for Cons.

Go for ITN sir.
1.Sir gives task after every topic he finishes as ClassWork.
Those are actually not necessarily have to be 100% accurate while answering. You will get 1 day to finish the CW. If you submit you get the marks. Basically sir will check if you are attentive and hard working enough.
2. Be sure you become attentive in the class and ask questions.
3.Try to get your confusions clear after the class or before the class. Don't wait for office hours repeatedly. Sir has a busy schedule on office hours (as sir takes many courses students are always there to meet).
4.Sir gives question based on what he teaches on class. Sometimes sir points out exercises from the book which you should practice before attending the exam. Sir slightly changes/or keeps the same question as exercise(As sir instructs)
5.Sir is friendly enough and is actually a very chill faculty.
6.Will curve you enough if you are attentive and try hard.
7.Make sure you behave well and dedicated enough to work hard under him.
8.End of the semester you will get more than you deserve!!!
Thanks
